name: @absolutejs/support
description: Support tickets for AbsoluteJS applications: a report becomes a ticket with its context (page, browser, release, error, replay), a threaded conversation with internal notes, assignment, priority and status, and response-time analytics. Drizzle-native, Postgres.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/drizzle.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=bun --external drizzle-orm --external 'drizzle-orm/*' && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && absolute-changelog check
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
